title: Local free model for interpretation tasks with template fallback
scope: Add an optional local, free model (e.g. via Ollama) behind the existing briefing/interpretation model interfaces, with the deterministic template as fallback; no paid keys; record model id, prompt version and settings on every output

acceptance.text: A provider-neutral model adapter with a local open-weights default, resource limits suitable for the demo laptop, timeouts, and automatic fallback to the deterministic template; every output records model id, prompt version and whether the fallback was used

Briefings for the five scenarios keep citations and injection resistance (TAX-056 fixtures) with the model enabled; three repeated runs are measured; the UI and demo clearly disclose model versus template output
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Briefings for the five scenarios keep citations and injection resistance (TAX-056 fixtures) with the model enabled; three repeated runs are measured; the UI and demo clearly disclose model versus template output
